text:
Nadia M.: Idea: pop-up coffee cart + mini recognition cards next Wed during lunch (11:30-1). Quick surprise for teams to drop a 1-line thank-you card and nominate a spontaneous spot award. Low-effort, high-visibility. Who can help logistics and cover a small gift-card budget? :coffee: :sparkles:

Alex G.: Love this. I can coordinate with Facilities for a location. Any preferences? Lobby or floor 3 atrium?

Facilities Bot: Recommended: Floor 3 atrium for higher foot traffic. Need 24h heads-up for cart vendor access and load-in.

Nadia M.: Floor 3 sounds great. Budget ask: $200 for vendor + $150 in $25 spot gift-cards (6 cards). Finance Ops, ok to expense under Culture/Spot?

Finance Ops: Approve provisional spend. Please submit PO for vendor and include project=Culture, code=POP-SPOT. Keep receipts.

Rita S.: I can design the mini cards (front: "One small thank-you" back: short nom QR). Will do two sizes (desk drop and handout). Also can we include a tiny sticker?

Marketing Ops: I can send a photographer for 15 mins. Also will make a micro-banner for the cart. Please collect photo consent on a checkbox on the sign-in pad.

Nadia M.: Great. Volunteers: need two folks to staff the cart 11:30-12 and 12-1. Also someone to manage the nomination triage (collect QR responses + flag any manager nominees). Ibrahim?

Ibrahim K.: I can do 12-1 shift and capture nominations in a Google sheet.

HR Ops Bot: Reminder: Spot awards policy: employees + contractors eligible if < $200. Manager approvals required for awards > $50. Use form field 'Manager Approval' for any manager-initiated nominations.

Alex G.: I'll do the 11:30-12 slot. Rita, can you deliver printed cards by Tue EOD?

Rita S.: Yup, printing on Tue. Need counts per office? HQ only this time, remote kits later.

Nadia M.: HQ-only pilot. Headcount ~130. Print 200 cards. Also need sticky-note pads (for quick shout-outs) and a small box for anonymous notes. Can Facilities help with a trolley for supplies?

Facilities Bot: Trolley reserved Tue 5pm pickup, will leave at reception Wed morning.

Finance Ops: For gift-cards to contractors, use non-cash vendor flow. Submit vendor-pay with tag POP-CTOR.

Marketing Ops: Photo consent checkbox added to sign-in sheet: https://go.redwood/sheets/pop-up-consent. We'll also create a social-safe image pack without employee names if anyone opts out.

Nadia M.: Quick accessibility note: please ensure cart area is clear for folks using mobility devices and have large-print cards available. @Rita can you do a high-contrast version?

Rita S.: Will make high-contrast alternate and label them.

Nadia M.: Final timeline:

```text
Tue EOD - final prints & high-contrast cards ready
Wed 9:30 - Facilities set up cart in floor 3 atrium
Wed 11:30-12 - Alex on shift
Wed 12-13 - Ibrahim on shift + Marketing photos (11:45-12:00)
Wed 14:00 - tally nominations + hand off to recognition committee
Within 7 days - submit expenses (project=Culture, code=POP-SPOT)
```

Alex G.: Adding volunteers to sign-up sheet now: https://go.redwood/sheets/pop-up-signup

Nadia M.: Thanks everyone. If this goes well we can scale to SF/London next month. I'll post a reminder in #general Tue morning. :raised_hands:
